h1: Autonomous AI Agents for Antigua and Barbuda
sub: Empower your business with 24/7 cloud bots that handle maritime logistics, guest concierge services, and cross-platform workflows independently.
audience: Yacht charter operators in English Harbour, luxury resort managers across Dickenson Bay, import merchants in St. John's, and Caribbean legal and financial advisors.
manifesto: From bustling docks in English Harbour to corporate desks in St. John's, Ceyo runs dedicated cloud computers that manage bookings, parse shipping invoices, and perform complex research nonstop, even while your devices are offline.

uses.d: Automate berth inquiries, guest preference sheets, and provisioning schedules across Falmouth and English Harbour marinas without manual data entry.
Deploy Telegram and voice agents to handle international guest queries, dining reservations, and catamaran tour bookings in real time.
Instruct your autonomous agent to read shipping invoices, match customs classifications, and sync inventory tables with your St. John's warehouse.
Track freight and inventory movements between Antigua and Barbuda automatically, sending instant Telegram alerts to logistics teams.
Let your bot search Caribbean and international marine suppliers, extract real-time pricing, and assemble structured vendor comparisons.
Track regional real estate listings, compile due diligence dossiers, and draft client summary decks inside your secure cloud computer.

steps.d: Create an isolated 24/7 virtual computer in seconds and define its specialist role.
Connect Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs, and your custom document libraries.
Delegate continuous research, booking management, and scheduled operational reporting.

chapters.d: At 07:00 AM, your bot gathers international charter updates and syncs dock schedules into Google Sheets. It delivers a condensed operational summary to your crew's Telegram group before the day begins.
While you manage clients in town, your agent processes incoming maritime customs documents and updates inventory records. Discrepancies are flagged automatically without taking up your desk hours.

An overseas visitor requests a last-minute island tour; your AI concierge browses live partner schedules and coordinates the booking. The itinerary is finalized and confirmed directly via messaging channels.

While your devices are turned off, your dedicated cloud computer continues running market research and financial reconciliation. It preps your morning dossiers so you can start the next day ahead of schedule.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and what does the trial include?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, requiring a card on file that is only billed after the trial concludes.

faq.q: Does my bot stay active when my phone or laptop is off?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer 24 hours a day, executing scheduled workflows, browsing the web, and processing files independently of your local hardware or internet connection.

faq.q: Can I use Ceyo through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can interact with your agents directly through personal Telegram bots or add multiple specialist bots into Telegram group chats to collaborate on complex projects as a team.

faq.q: What languages and workflows are supported?
faq.a: Ceyo handles multilingual communication, including English and major international languages. It can write and execute code, browse websites, manage CRMs, handle phone calls, and automate over 1,000 everyday business apps.

faq.q: How is my commercial data protected?
faq.a: Your bots operate within dedicated, sandboxed cloud environments. Long-term memory, uploaded files, and internal records remain strictly segregated and accessible only to your authorized bot network.
